title: Which Animal Can Regrow Limbs and Parts of Its Brain?
description:
This salamander can rebuild structures that humans replace with scar tissue.

The axolotl can regenerate limbs, spinal cord, parts of the heart and parts of the central nervous system.

After injury, cells form a blastema that grows and re-patterns the missing structure.

Regeneration restores complex tissues in the correct arrangement, not just a simple stump.
